semantic_notes: The ordinary enumeration of the three labels does not induce increasing spaced priorities; the priority-sorted and ordinary restricted orders differ. These are concrete inverse-observation/order counterexamples, not a new order assumption.

For the incomplete but duplicate-free positions [0] on Fin2, swap0/1 sends the selected label outside the observations: the output is [] and fails the intended orders support. This retains the completeness necessity independently of Nodup.

For complete repeated positions [0,0,1] on Fin2, the same swap yields [1,1,0], which is outside orders support. This retains the Nodup necessity independently of completeness and exposes multiplicity, rather than merely a different ordering.

runsOpsBy, ascOpsBy and descOpsBy accept arbitrary payload types and Boolean comparators without typeclass assumptions. The ascending helper receives the actual DifferenceListCosts.Builder; the descending helper uses a list accumulator. All return Measured (List (List alpha)) Nat.
The actual empty and singleton scanner equations retain respective measured values ([],1) and ([[a]],3), including operational work instead of replacing it by value-only zero.
